True when `open_call` or `open_metered_call` was invoked by another Solana program through CPI.
Program invoked on `on_receipt` inside `settle_call`. The default (all-zero) address means no callback.
Up to 8 `CallbackAccount` entries (`pubkey`, `is_writable`) passed to `callback_program::on_receipt` after `[receipt, call, model]`.
Whether the call is priced per `Call` (`0`) or per output `Token` (`1`), snapshotted from the model.
Escrow ceiling in base units of `price_mint`. Equals `price` for `Call` calls; for `Token` calls it is the caller-supplied maximum escrow deposited by `open_metered_call`.
